title: Penguin Solutions Expands ClusterWareAI Operating System Software for AI Factories with AI-Powered Operations and Automated Remediation
summary: New AI Factory Operations Agent, Automated GPU Remediation for Kubernetes Workloads, and Expanded Health Visibility Improve AI Factory Performance and Resilience Penguin Solutions , Inc. Penguin Solutions is the AI Factory Platform Company. We design, build, and manage next-generation data centers for enterprises, sovereign AI initiatives, and neocloud providers.
